metadata.scenario: A woman calls for the first time asking about in-home physical therapy for her elderly father after hip surgery. She asks about pricing and weekly visit frequency. The receptionist provides a quote for three visits per week at $120 per session. The caller is relieved and says she'll confirm tomorrow. First-time caller.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, my name is Sarah. I'm calling because my father just had hip surgery, and I’m looking into in-home physical therapy for him. Of course, Sarah. I can help you with that. How is your father doing? He’s recovering well, but the doctor recommended physical therapy to help him regain mobility. That sounds like a good plan. We provide physical therapy services at home. Great! Can you tell me about your pricing and how often he would need to see a therapist? Sure! Our in-home physical therapy sessions are priced at $110 to $140 per visit. Most clients find that three sessions a week work well. Okay, so if I go with three sessions a week, what would that cost? If we go with the average rate of $120 per session, that would be $360 a week. That’s manageable. How soon can we get started? We can typically schedule the first visit within a few days, depending on the therapist's availability. That sounds good. I’ll need to confirm with my dad, but I think we’ll go ahead with it. Perfect! Just let me know, and I can set everything up once you’ve confirmed. Will do! Are there any options for payment or insurance coverage? Yes, we accept various insurance plans. I can check your father's coverage if you provide me with the details. That would be really helpful. I’ll gather that information and call you back tomorrow. Sounds like a plan! Would you like to schedule a specific time for that call? How about the same time tomorrow? Does that work for you? Yes, I’ll be here at this time tomorrow. Just give me a call! Thank you, Margaret. I really appreciate your help with this. You’re very welcome, Sarah! I look forward to hearing from you. Have a great day! You too! Goodbye.
